01 / THE INTENTION

Give the object
a presence.

The brief was self-directed: create a distinctive audio-commerce experience that balances the atmosphere of a product film with the usefulness of a storefront.

The result centres on an original family of three procedural headphone models. Material, silhouette and light tell the story. A direct model selector compares Orbit, Studio and Planar. Manual controls let a visitor inspect each silhouette at their own pace.

FORMA is a fictional brand. The project demonstrates design and implementation decisions, with no client commission, sales results or real product specifications claimed.

Original 3D geometryEditorial interfaceReal-time WebGLResponsive design

02 / THE EXPERIENCE

Atmosphere first.
Clarity throughout.

Try the configuration ↗
  1. 01

    Meet the object.

    A studio-lit 3D viewer presents three original designs. Rotation, zoom, model selection and reset controls keep exploration in the visitor's hands.

  2. 02

    Choose with confidence.

    Essential and Travel sets show their contents and illustrative prices together. A clear configuration step leads into a working local cart.

  3. 03

    See the complete picture.

    Quantity changes update line totals, delivery and order totals. The cart can be restored after a browser reload, with a sample order available as a JSON download.

  4. 04

    Set your own pace.

    Reduced-motion preferences and manual scene controls support a quieter experience. The implementation includes a static rendering fallback when a 3D scene cannot be shown.

03 / THE IMPLEMENTATION

The details behind
the first impression.

A considered surface needs a dependable foundation. The commerce logic is kept separate from the visual experience.

10 tests

The automated cart suite covers quantities, delivery thresholds, invalid data, storage input and sample-order export.

Integer cents

Line items and totals use whole currency cents. Quantities and bundle names are validated before calculations.

Local only

Browser storage retains a sample cart. No account, real payment or customer information is required.

04 / THE HANDOFF

A complete concept.
An honest scope.

The deliverable includes buildless HTML, CSS and JavaScript, locally bundled Three.js, three custom 3D models, responsive layouts and a separately tested cart module. Manual controls, reduced-motion support and a static image fallback are part of the experience.

The cart and JSON export are demonstrations. They make the interaction tangible without processing a transaction.

PRODUCTION BOUNDARYThis is a fictional product demonstration. Payments, inventory, tax integration, fulfilment, customer accounts and transactional email are outside its scope. A commercial launch would require those systems and verified product information.

Designed to be experienced.
